title: Enrollment Term, Leaving and Re-Enrollment Terms of the Demand Response Programs
content:
## Term and exit terms by program

The Demand Response Programs set, for each program, the commitment term of an enrollment, when leaving takes effect, the period after activation within which leaving forfeits the enrollment bonus, the number of consecutive non-performing events that removes an enrollment, the lockout after a removal, and whether the enrollment moves with the customer. A value of 0 means none.

| Program | Commitment term | Leaving takes effect | Bonus clawback period after activation | Consecutive events with no delivered reduction, not opted out, that remove the enrollment | Re-enrollment lockout after a removal | Enrollment moves with the customer to a new service agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | 0 months (none) | On the request date | 0 months (no clawback) | 0 (none) | 0 months | Yes |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | 12 months | On the request date | 12 months | 3 | 12 months | No |
| AC Cycling Program | 12 months | On the request date; the switch is left in place inactive | 12 months | 0 (none) | 12 months | No |
| Home Battery Dispatch | 36 months | On the request date | 0 months (no clawback) | 3 | 12 months | No |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | 12 months | End of the program month | 0 months (no clawback) | 3 | 12 months | No |
| Base Interruptible Program | 12 months | End of the program year, on written notice given in November | 0 months (no clawback) | 2 | 12 months | No |

## Terms explained

- **Commitment term.** Peak Time Rebate has none; Home Battery Dispatch runs 36 months; every other program 12 months.
- **When leaving takes effect.** For the four residential programs, on the date of the request; for the AC Cycling Program the company's switch stays on the air conditioning unit, inactive. A Commercial Capacity Bidding Program exit takes effect at the end of the program month. A Base Interruptible Program exit takes effect at the end of the program year, on written notice given in November.
- **Bonus clawback period.** 12 months after activation for Smart Thermostat Rewards and the AC Cycling Program; the other programs have no clawback.
- **Removal for non-performance.** Three consecutive events with no delivered reduction, not opted out, remove a Smart Thermostat Rewards, Home Battery Dispatch or Commercial Capacity Bidding Program enrollment; two remove a Base Interruptible Program enrollment. Peak Time Rebate and the AC Cycling Program have no such count.
- **Re-enrollment lockout.** 12 months after a removal for every program except Peak Time Rebate, which has none.
- **Moving.** Only a Peak Time Rebate enrollment moves with the customer to a new service agreement.

## Illustrations (hypothetical enrollments)

| Hypothetical case | Program | Result under the table |
|---|---|---|
| Customer leaves in the 7th month after activation | Smart Thermostat Rewards | Within the 12-month clawback period |
| Customer leaves in the 7th month after activation | Home Battery Dispatch | No clawback period applies |
| 2 consecutive events with no delivered reduction, not opted out | Base Interruptible Program | Reaches the removal count of 2 |
| 2 consecutive events with no delivered reduction, not opted out | Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | Below the removal count of 3 |
| Customer moves to a new address | Peak Time Rebate | Enrollment moves with the customer |
| Customer moves to a new address | AC Cycling Program | Enrollment does not move |
